questions.q: Culture of faeces in typhoid fever is most often positive during the:
questions.why: Blood culture is positive in the first week, Widal from the second, and stool culture mainly in the third and fourth weeks ('BASU' sequence).

questions.q: The 'Tzanck smear' showing multinucleated giant cells is used to diagnose:
opts: herpes virus infections such as chickenpox
questions.why: Topic 6, Pathology, Microbiology and Diagnostics. A bedside test.

questions.q: A competitive inhibitor of an enzyme:
opts: lowers Vmax but leaves Km unchanged
raises Vmax but leaves Km unchanged
raises the apparent Km but leaves Vmax unchanged
questions.why: The inhibitor competes for the active site, so more substrate is needed for half-maximal velocity, but enough substrate still reaches the same Vmax.

questions.q: The first volume of the Homoeopathic Pharmacopoeia of India was published in:
questions.why: HPI Volume I appeared in 1971; further volumes followed.

questions.q: The most important mechanism in GERD is (GPSC Medical Officer, 2024):
opts: frequent transient lower oesophageal sphincter relaxations
questions.why: Topic 7, Practice of Medicine. Transient LES relaxations allow reflux.

questions.q: Pure motor hemiparesis of face, arm and leg without aphasia, visual field loss or sensory deficit in a long-standing hypertensive suggests:
questions.why: Lacunar infarcts from hypertensive small-vessel disease in the internal capsule cause pure motor or pure sensory strokes without cortical signs.

questions.q: A woman with uterine haemorrhage who finds music intolerable, as it makes her nervous, needs:
questions.why: Sabina (Boericke): music is intolerable and produces nervousness; uterine bleeding with pain from sacrum to pubis.

questions.q: In Poonam Verma v. Ashwin Patel (1996), the Supreme Court held that a homoeopath prescribing allopathic drugs without the required qualification is:
opts: protected under the Consumer Protection Act
guilty only if the patient dies
not negligent if the drug is commonly used
questions.why: Practising a system of medicine without qualification in it was held to be negligence per se.

questions.q: A deep-vein thrombus that reaches the systemic arterial circulation through a patent foramen ovale is called:
questions.why: Paradoxical (crossed) embolism occurs when a venous embolus passes through an interatrial or interventricular defect into the systemic arteries.

questions.q: The earliest clinical sign of rickets in a young infant is:
questions.why: Craniotabes (ping-pong softening of the skull) appears in early infancy; rosary and limb deformities come later.
